## Search videos by sponsored brand mention

```json
{
  "size": 50,
  "query": {
    "term": {
      "sponsored_brand_mentions": "5612"
    }
  },
  "_source": [
    "title",
    "channel.id",
    "publication_date",
    "views"
  ],
  "sort": [
    {
      "publication_date": "desc"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Count sponsored mentions for a brand (size:0 + track_total_hits)

```json
{
  "size": 0,
  "track_total_hits": true,
  "query": {
    "term": {
      "sponsored_brand_mentions": "5612"
    }
  }
}
```

## Full-text search on title/summary/transcript

```json
{
  "size": 20,
  "query": {
    "multi_match": {
      "query": "ergonomic keyboard review",
      "fields": [
        "title^3",
        "summary",
        "transcript"
      ]
    }
  },
  "_source": [
    "title",
    "channel.id",
    "publication_date"
  ]
}
```
